title: Freightliner CST112 Columbia Hi-tensile FUPS Bullbar #11
description: Freightliner CST112 Columbia hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar. 76mm diameter hi-tensile 6mm wall pipe. Driving light mounts to customer spec. Fully gusseted contoured main channel to suit truck design. Tow pin mounted to heavy duty steel backing plate, provision for front mudflaps. Contoured main channel. Indicator repeater lights mounted in outer box uprights. Provision for front mudflaps. Bullbar can me custom built to your specifications.
